name: content-library
description: The indexed backlog of all approved marketing copy and the searchable catalogue of brand visual assets. Prevents duplication by making existing approved content findable before new content is commissioned. Integrated with brand-asset-manager for asset discovery.

commands.name: content-find
commands.description: Search the Content Library for existing copy or assets

commands.name: content-store
commands.description: Add approved copy or asset references to the library

commands.name: content-browse
commands.description: Browse the full library or a specific category; run audits
